sql.sql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "settings" ("key" TEXT NOT NULL, "value" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT (CAST(strftime('%s', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AS INTEGER)), PRIMARY KEY ("key"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "diagnostic_log_segments" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "run_id" TEXT NULL, "sequence_start" INTEGER NOT NULL, "sequence_end" INTEGER NOT NULL, "original_byte_length" INTEGER NOT NULL, "compressed_byte_length" INTEGER NOT NULL, "compressed_bytes" BLOB NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT (CAST(strftime('%s', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AS INTEGER)), PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "owned_resources" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "kind" TEXT NOT NULL, "path" TEXT NOT NULL, "run_id" TEXT NULL, "process_id" INTEGER NULL, "state" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT (CAST(strftime('%s', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AS INTEGER)), "last_reconciled_at" INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "local_users" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "email" TEXT NULL UNIQUE, "auth_method" TEXT NOT NULL, "verifier_key" TEXT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "last_authenticated_at" INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "local_recovery_codes" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "user_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES local_users (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "digest" TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE, "issued_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "consumed_at" INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "audit_events" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "actor_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "action" TEXT NOT NULL, "target" TEXT NOT NULL, "outcome" TEXT NOT NULL, "occurred_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "details" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "projects" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "normalized_name" TEXT NOT NULL COLLATE NOCASE UNIQUE, "folder_path" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "deleted_at" INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "workflows" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "revision" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK("revision" >= 1), "name" TEXT NULL, "is_reusable" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK ("is_reusable" IN (0, 1)), "unit_type" TEXT NOT NULL, "supervised_delivery" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("supervised_delivery" IN (0, 1)), "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "deleted_at" INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "workflow_steps" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "workflow_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES workflows (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "position" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK("position" >= 0), "kind" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "cli" TEXT NULL CHECK ((cli IS NULL) = (model IS NULL)), "model" TEXT NULL, "configuration" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}', PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "workflow_project_refs" ("workflow_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES workflows (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "project_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES projects (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, PRIMARY KEY ("workflow_id", "project_id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "workflow_runs" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "project_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES projects (id) ON DELETE SET NULL, "workflow_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES workflows (id) ON DELETE SET NULL, "label" TEXT NOT NULL, "status" TEXT NOT NULL, "current_step_position" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK("current_step_position" >= 0), "branch_name" TEXT NULL UNIQUE, "worktree_path" TEXT NULL UNIQUE, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "started_at" INTEGER NULL, "completed_at" INTEGER NULL, "deleted_at" INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "run_snapshots" ("run_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES workflow_runs (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "schema_version" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK("schema_version" >= 1), "canonical_payload" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("run_id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "run_snapshot_steps" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "run_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES workflow_runs (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "source_workflow_step_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "position" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK("position" >= 0), "kind" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "cli" TEXT NULL CHECK ((cli IS NULL) = (model IS NULL)), "model" TEXT NULL, "configuration" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "run_attempts" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "run_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES workflow_runs (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "snapshot_step_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES run_snapshot_steps (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, "attempt_number" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK("attempt_number" > 0), "status" TEXT NOT NULL, "started_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "completed_at" INTEGER NULL, "exit_code" INTEGER NULL, "failure_code" TEXT NULL, "declared_context" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"), FOREIGN KEY (run_id, snapshot_step_id) REFERENCES run_snapshot_steps (run_id, id) ON DELETE RESTRICT);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "run_log_segments" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "run_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES workflow_runs (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "attempt_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES run_attempts (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "snapshot_step_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES run_snapshot_steps (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, "sequence" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK("sequence" >= 0), "channel" TEXT NOT NULL, "bytes" BLOB NOT NULL, "compression" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'none', "original_byte_length" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK("original_byte_length" >= 0), "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"), FOREIGN KEY (run_id, attempt_id, snapshot_step_id) REFERENCES run_attempts (run_id, id, snapshot_step_id) ON DELETE CASCADE);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "run_recovery_requests" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "run_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES workflow_runs (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "attempt_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES run_attempts (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, "action" TEXT NOT NULL, "status" TEXT NOT NULL, "requested_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"), FOREIGN KEY (run_id, attempt_id) REFERENCES run_attempts (run_id, id) ON DELETE RESTRICT);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "delivery_records" ("run_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES workflow_runs (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "repository" TEXT NOT NULL, "issue_number" INTEGER NOT NULL, "branch_name" TEXT NOT NULL, "head_commit" TEXT NOT NULL, "pull_request_number" INTEGER NULL, "pull_request_url" TEXT NULL, "reviewer_identity" TEXT NULL, "review_outcome" TEXT NULL, "findings" TEXT NOT NULL, "merge_commit" TEXT NULL, "issue_closed" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK ("issue_closed" IN (0, 1)), "branch_deleted" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK ("branch_deleted" IN (0, 1)), "failure_code" TEXT NULL, "remediation" TEXT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "completed_at" INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("run_id"));
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX local_users_single_operating_system ON local_users (auth_method) WHERE auth_method = 'operatingSystem'
CREATE INDEX local_recovery_codes_unused_digest ON local_recovery_codes (digest) WHERE consumed_at IS NULL
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX workflow_steps_workflow_position ON workflow_steps (workflow_id, position)
CREATE INDEX workflow_project_refs_project ON workflow_project_refs (project_id)
CREATE INDEX workflow_runs_project_status ON workflow_runs (project_id, status)
CREATE INDEX workflow_runs_status ON workflow_runs (status)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX run_snapshot_steps_run_position ON run_snapshot_steps (run_id, position)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX run_snapshot_steps_run_identity ON run_snapshot_steps (run_id, id)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX run_attempts_step_number ON run_attempts (run_id, snapshot_step_id, attempt_number)
CREATE INDEX run_attempts_run_status ON run_attempts (run_id, status)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX run_attempts_run_identity ON run_attempts (run_id, id)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX run_attempts_run_identity_step ON run_attempts (run_id, id, snapshot_step_id)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX run_attempts_one_active_step ON run_attempts (run_id, snapshot_step_id) WHERE status IN ('starting', 'running')
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX run_log_segments_attempt_sequence ON run_log_segments (attempt_id, sequence)
CREATE INDEX run_log_segments_run ON run_log_segments (run_id)
CREATE INDEX run_recovery_requests_run_status ON run_recovery_requests (run_id, status)
